title: Fix scroll-area test: use children instead of content
body:
The scroll-area component test was using `content` property, but `ScrollAreaSchema` defines `children` and the renderer expects `schema.children`.

**Change**
```diff
 const { container } = renderComponent({
   type: 'scroll-area',
-  content: [{ type: 'text', content: 'Scrollable content' }],
+  children: [{ type: 'text', content: 'Scrollable content' }],
 });
```

The renderer implementation:
```typescript
// src/renderers/complex/scroll-area.tsx
{renderChildren(schema.children)}
```

Type definition:
```typescript
export interface ScrollAreaSchema extends BaseSchema {
  children?: SchemaNode | SchemaNode[];
}
```
